market_name: Will 1 Fed rate cut happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market probability move coincides with any macro data release (CPI, jobs) or Fed speak; if driven by public news, discount signal. Watch 2Y and 10Y yields and TLT tick.
time_plan.1h: Confirm direction persists in fed funds futures (SOFR strip) and DXY; verify TLT move isn't just noise around a flat tape.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether long-end yields are following front-end; if curve steepening from growth fears, TLT gains may fade.
time_plan.6h: Compare against overnight index swap repricing and any Fed official commentary; update if move has reversed.
time_plan.12h: Mark final TLT return vs. baseline; log whether the market-implied cut probability shift preceded any public catalyst.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of Fed rate cuts in 2026 signals a more dovish rate path, which lowers expected front-end and belly yields and pushes bond prices up. TLT is a liquid, high-duration proxy that responds mechanically to shifts in Fed easing expectations. However, an 'at least 1 cut in 2026' threshold is already close to fully priced in most macro regimes, so genuine information content from a move in THIS specific market is limited; most of the signal would come only from a regime-changing repricing (e.g., recession/emergency-cut fears).

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY spot and whether EUR/USD, USD/JPY moved concurrently with the probability shift.
time_plan.1h: Confirm move is rate-driven, not risk-off dollar bid (which would flip the sign).
time_plan.2h: Reassess against Treasury yield direction; dollar and yields usually move together on Fed repricing.
time_plan.6h: Update if global risk sentiment or foreign central-bank news dominates.
time_plan.12h: Record final UUP return and note whether the FX move was consistent with a dovish Fed repricing.

predictions.reasoning: Rising odds of Fed cuts typically weaken the dollar via lower expected real rate differentials. UUP is a liquid dollar proxy. The mapping is weak here because a single-cut threshold for a full year is low-information and dollar moves depend heavily on relative central-bank paths (ECB, BoJ) that this market does not capture.

evidence_used: Market question tracks number of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026, a direct Fed-policy expectation gauge
Standard macro transmission: dovish repricing lowers yields, weakens USD, supports duration
Threshold is 'at least 1 cut,' which is typically high-probability and low-information in most regimes
uncertainty_notes: The 700bp tradability threshold is far above realistic 12h moves for liquid rate/FX ETFs, so neither prediction is 'tradable' under the stated rule
'At least 1 cut in 2026' is likely already near-certain; marginal probability moves carry little new information
Topic tag 'military_conflict' appears mislabeled; this is a pure monetary-policy market
Direction can invert if the probability shift is driven by growth/recession fear (risk-off dollar bid, equity selloff) rather than pure dovishness

llm_justification.summary: This is a Fed-easing-expectations market. A sharp rise in the implied probability of a 2026 rate cut maps to a dovish repricing: lower Treasury yields (TLT up) and a softer dollar (UUP down). But the 'at least one cut' threshold is low-information and usually near fully priced, so the signal is weak. Expected 12h magnitudes (~15–25bp) are far below the 700bp tradability bar, so these are research-only, low-confidence mappings.
key_assumptions: A move in this market reflects genuine repricing of the Fed path rather than resolution mechanics or noise
Rate cuts are read as growth-neutral/dovish rather than emergency-recession signals
Standard rate-transmission channels hold over the 12h window
failure_modes: The probability move reflects already-public information (CPI print, FOMC minutes) and is fully priced before any trade
Cuts are priced as recession-driven emergency easing, flipping the dollar to a safe-haven bid and pressuring equities
The 'at least 1 cut' threshold is near 100%, so probability moves are microscopic and carry no tradable information
TLT/UUP exposure to this specific annual-count question is diffuse; foreign central-bank paths dominate FX, weakening the proxy
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
